records.reviewer_finding: Read complete pinned SKILL.md, root MIT LICENSE, script score_cue.py and example cue_reveal.json. In cmd_render, name=spec.get('name') is interpolated into outdir/name.wav, name.mid and name_raw.wav. Absolute or parent-relative names can escape; ffmpeg uses -y. Static code finding, not executed proof.
